The doctor did a good job, but the staff didn't inform me of the details. When I called to inquire, they said I could use my insurance, and after deductions, I would only have to pay a certain amount. Ultimately, I had to pay myself because they said they couldn't process the claim anymore; the procedure needed to be done before 3 PM. I wasn't aware of this at all. I didn't know anything about it. They said they couldn't take responsibility. If the clinic can't even cover for their staff's mistake, why should I have to pay when they didn't do anything wrong? Many dental clinics accept social security, and they manage to do this without any problems. I can't find a reason why I should have to pay myself. Finally, they told me to follow up with social security myself. Is that fair? I had urgent work to do. You lost one thing, I lost both money and work time, but the clinic lost nothing; they just passed all the blame on to the customer.
After a 9-month wait, the crown and dental implant are finally complete today. Dr. Pimchanok, her assistants, and the staff did an excellent job! The result is beautiful; I'm very impressed.
